notes.title: The Night is Grey Patch 1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

First of all thank you for supporting this passion project.
We just updated the games's build into 1.4 that improves and adds the following:

• Added some extra tutorial hints on chapter 2 about using the space bar for hotspot finder
• Added some puzzle visual cues on both power box and connector box puzzle
• Added more visual cues to the map in chapter 3
• Changed the hint for the pirate lock to help push the player in the right direction
• Added the schematics to the vent puzzle for each machine to minimize back and forth.
• Added some minor visual enhancements
• Some small corrections on the dialogues and documents.
• Fixed a game stuck bug in the lighthouse

[b]Thank you everyone for feedback and support,
Whalestork team.[/b]

notes.title: The Night is Grey Patch 1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

First of all thank you for supporting this passion project.
We just updated the games's build into [b]1.2[/b] that improves and adds the following:

•  [b]Added a new simple hint system in the zoomed in puzzles.[/b] A icon will appear on the up right corner and by pressing it, you have a simple multi step hint system. Giving you a simple hint or a more straightforward one. (just make sure you have hint mode ON for this)

•  Added a trigger warning disclaimer in the games start loading screen.
•  Added a small reminder tutorial in Ch2
•  Added a brand new music during a cutscene
•  Game start load time improvement
•  Some corrections on the dialogues
•  Readjusted the mine map visibility
•  Fixed hints spots not showing outside the office in Ch2
•  Fixed a small visual bug in the mine

Just make sure that you have the minimum required specs
to run the game mentioned the steam game page store.

We are still improving the game's build.

[b]Thank you for the support,
Whalestork team.[/b]

notes.title: THE NIGHT IS GREY RELEASE DATE REVEAL
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37301806/f8b538cdb1e3600a057986d56dc734f1f945ffb3.gif[/img]

Release JAN 5th 2024

We are so excited to announce that The Night is Grey is finally finished and will be available to play on Steam this January 5th!

It’s been a long and hard journey with lots of missteps and tribulations but we are really proud of what we accomplished. We want to thank the unwavering support of those that stuck with us in spite of the delays and all the doubts that come with a team’s first game.

It’s been a 7 year journey and this is one of the most rewarding things we’ve done in our lives. We hope that just like us, when you play it you feel it was worth the wait. 

See you soon?

notes.title: THE NIGHT IS GREY - DEMO UPDATE V1.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone, [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37301806/421134eba8b3bc3320a0fe256454ba0d0ef66cca.gif[/img]

[b]The wolves are listening[/b], and to prove so, here's our first demo update with a good range of fixes, optimizations and new gameplay elements.

[b][list]
[*] Added 2 new unique Graham animations
[/list][/b] Graham now checks his smokes & has a new conversational animation

[b][list]
[*] Added a ingame tutorial
[/list][/b]The context based tutorial explains where's the inventory and that you can use items on the characters

[b][list]
[*] Added right click to fast travel to locations
[/list][/b]You can now right click to fast travel between locations

[b][list]
[*] Added more unique item/dialogue interactions
[/list][/b] Implemented Graham reacts with new dialogue prompts for various items/hotspots

[b][list]
[*] Graham walk speed up 40%
[/list][/b] We heard, and Graham walks faster into danger.

[b][list]
[*] Text speed up 20%
[/list][/b] A little tweak to make reading more organic

[b][list]
[*] Game menu loads faster
[/list][/b] No explanation needed here

[b][list]
[*] Fixed 3 hotspots location range
[/list][/b] The hotspots for the notepad,  generator lid, and house pathway have been adjusted

[b][list]
[*] Hotspot indicator more evident
[/list][/b] The mouse cursor now indicates more evidently when you hover on a hotspot

[b][list]
[*] Improved overall game speed
[/list][/b] Various tweak to make the game play faster, including scene transitions.

[b][list]
[*] Various visual & sound tweaks
[/list][/b] Added new and previously missing sounds. Leveled various sounds to match the scene.


Thank you for your feedback & support, enjoy our demo. 
If you stream our demo feel free to give us a shoutout, maybe we'll meet you there.

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/WhalestorkGames]twitter[/url]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/SGUC4f6p]Discord[/url]
